Champion's Path

Released September 25, 2020 · 80 cards

Expanded

Champion's Path is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sword & Shield series, released in English on September 25, 2020. Its main set has 73 cards, plus 7 secret rares numbered beyond the set (80 in total). It includes 57 Pokémon, 23 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

40 illustrators worked on Champion's Path. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (8), aky CG Works (7), Ryo Ueda (5), Naoki Saito (4), Akira Komayama (3), kirisAki (3), nagimiso (3), PLANETA Mochizuki (3).
